heard: Old stars here suck life from neighbors to survive. Messier 30 is a 13 billion year old dense star cluster. Its core collapsed into a dense stellar traffic jam. Half the cluster's mass squeezed into a tiny sphere. Stars collided or entered tight binary loops together. Some became cosmic vampires stealing hydrogen fuel from partners. This fresh mass reversed their aging process completely. Hubble images prove these vampires defy cosmic aging rules. They burn blue again by draining their friends dry.
